titulo: Portugal: Cristiano Ronaldo controversy rumbles on
cuerpo: The controversy between Cristiano Ronaldo and Portugal coach Jorge Jesus continues, following the lengthy statement released by the forward on Tuesday. Ronaldo explained his decision to leave the Portugal squad and accused his coach of breaking his word. The affair has dominated the headlines in the Portuguese press, overshadowing Portugal's four Nations League victories. The media are questioning his future while Ronaldo insists he wants to continue playing for the Seleçao.
